title: Hadwiger Conjecture
exact_target: If a graph cannot contain a complete graph of order $t+1$ even after contractions, must $t$ colors suffice?

sources.citation: Lafferty and Song, Every graph with no K\_8\textasciicircum{}\{-4\} minor is 7-colorable (2022), abstract.
Disproof of the Odd Hadwiger Conjecture.
